title: 坐稳再抬膝
description: 成人坐稳长凳，轻抬一侧膝盖，躯干保持安静。

art_direction.medium: soft pastel drawing with clear contour accents
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult sits tall near the front of a stable bench, one hand resting lightly on the seat and the other relaxed beside the thigh. One knee lifts a little without leaning backward, while the opposite shoe remains firmly on the floor. Depict the torso quiet and the shoulders loose. A rolled mat and a plain gym bag beside the bench connect the accessible exercise to a practical training routine. Use etched-ink illustration with delicate controlled hatching, a few flat washes, and warm sepia balanced by pale turquoise. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels.
